about_the_game:
💀 GENDERMAN

Welcome to the dark, absurd world of GENDERMAN — a short and intense psychological horror experience.

You wake up in a silent forest scattered with notes and strange symbols. Your only goal: tear them all up before he finds you.
But every note you tear up puts you in greater danger.

🕹️ Gameplay

  • First-person psychological horror focused on exploration, stealth, and survival

  • Collect and tear up notes to uncover fragments of a disturbing story

  • Avoid Genderman, who becomes faster, louder, and more unpredictable over time

  • Dynamic sound design and an evolving atmosphere for maximum tension

  • Short, replayable sessions — 10–20 minutes of pure adrenaline

⚡ Features

🔥 Intense horror with dark humor and absurd moments
👁️ Simple yet immersive gameplay
🎭 A surreal blend of meme culture and psychological terror
🎧 Layered audio and atmosphere for deep immersion
🎮 Optimized for mouse & keyboard (PC)

💬 Summary

GENDERMAN is a disturbing yet fascinating horror experiment — somewhere between meme and madness.
Can you tear up all the notes… or will Genderman tear you apart?

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600 (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1660 (or AMD equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700 (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 (or AMD equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 12
